name: Nimbus
tagline: Open-source, EC2-style virtual machines on hardware you own, with HTTPS access and object storage in two clicks.

awards: Arista Networks: Connect the Dots Challenge

problem: Students and small teams need cloud-like infrastructure without cloud accounts, keys or egress costs.
solution: A single Go binary with an embedded React console orchestrates Proxmox to provision VMs with static IPs, exposes them through the team's own reverse-tunnel gateway and provisions MinIO buckets.
demo_moment: Team-described: provision a VM in about thirty seconds on a cluster of repurposed laptops brought to the event.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Arista Networks: Connect the Dots Challenge” and “High Quality Sponsormaxxing” among 307 submissions.
Brought a physical cluster of repurposed laptops to demo on.
Won a networking challenge and the sponsor-use prize.

lessons: Bring the infrastructure into the room; a live provision beats a slide.
